methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.
Only changing helper terminal subspaces and monotone frames within the fixed scalar word, entrances and cleanup contract already covered by #1995/#2013.

actual_scope: For q independent rank-one products over F2, build the exact output map F0=P, F1=Q, Fi=P+Q+Ri with two clean required result coordinates and arbitrary dirty remaining accumulators. Temporarily shear F0 by F1 to use P+Q as a fanout anchor, then restore F0=P. Verify exact rank/inverse for 3<=q<=112 and screen seven q=112 blocks with the exact selected ceiling and rank-one-equivalent interface tariff.
scope_change_reason: The broad card asks for a new local cost interface. This narrows it to a distinct two-output state contract: two required outputs hold separate common products, and one is temporarily sheared into their sum. The nearby one-output anchor contracts store the common sum as a required output and do not exercise this temporary output shear.
bottleneck_link: The selected complex local-word profile has 2,412 rank-one children and a fixed-profile packing ceiling. The q=112 block replaces 332 independent rank-one calls by 112 calls at equal-frame local scope, saving 220 child calls; exact ceiling screening tests whether that changed child profile survives a fully stated interface tariff.
stop_rule: Verify the local F2 map, inverse and exact rank for q=3..112; exhaust all Boolean inputs and dirty outputs for q=3,4,5. At q=112, screen up to seven direct 332-child groups and determine the exact largest integer added rank-one-equivalent tariff per block that meets the 5-percent gate. Stop after the local construction and tariff boundary; do not search the selected provider for matching source pairs in this cycle.
evidence: The temporary-sum-anchor schedule proves the map F0=P, F1=Q, Fi=P+Q+Ri with q rank-one products, q affine additions, no scratch helper, copies or frame changes; reversing it restores all entry values. The q output-slice matrices are independent, so the tensor rank is exactly q. Symbolic checks cover all 110 widths q=3..112; exhaustive Boolean input/dirty-target controls cover 9,344 cases at q=3,4,5. At q=112, the joint map uses 112 children; its simple separate-anchor fanout schedule uses 220 additions, while the temporary shear uses 112 and saves 108. Seven hypothetical independent 332-child groups could be replaced by 784 children, a 1,540-child reduction, and 784 affine additions. The exact zero-tariff ceiling exceeds the 5-percent target; with additional rank-one-equivalent tariff e per block, e=183 passes, e=184 fails, and e=220 returns to the selected profile. The tariff conversion, two-clean-output availability and selected-provider placement remain unproved; no supplier or kappa result follows.
